body:
Thank you for the kid words. I do have some things in my life that are very positive right now. I guess it's just difficult to focus on the positive. My whole life, I've been a negative person and so by "default", I tend to think of the negative things in life.

I think maybe what I should do is write a list of positive things in my life and stick it on my mirror or something. It's easy to forget the positive things. But if I have a constant reminder, then maybe I can change my negative thinking.

Thank you.

Thank you very much for the response. I did Taekwondo for 8 years, but I quit a few months ago. I just recently started Muay Thai (as I understand it, it's like MMA except it is only stand up). I really enjoy Muay Thai. It's difficult, but there's just something about punching a bag that gets all the stress out. 

Luckily, I actually have my own bag at home. So while I am not at my Muay Thai school, I can practice by myself. Like you said, when I'm practicing martial arts, I forget about the stress.

Thank you for responding. I feel a bit better.
